identity: RealHyFC long-horizon qualification v1; written before source outcome inspection

sufficiency.reason: An overlapping origin count is not an independent trajectory count. Require at least three non-overlapping target trajectories in training and two in validation for a minimally replicated within-cell comparison; this is an exploratory engineering gate, not a statistical power claim. Holdout outcomes/counts never choose a horizon.

target_A.formula: A_i = mean(V[i-47:i+1]), only if all 48 bins valid and clocks/segment continuous
target_A.unit: V per cell; not SOH or irreversible degradation

target_B.formula: B_raw_i = V_i - (z_i-z_train_median) @ beta; beta fitted by OLS with intercept on valid TRAIN only; B_i=causal trailing-48 mean of supported B_raw
target_B.support: All covariates finite and within each valid TRAIN covariate min/max; no extrapolation; box support is necessary but not sufficient for joint comparability
target_B.unit: V per cell; statistical condition-adjusted voltage, not validated SOH

target_gates.extra_checks: Report raw/trend roughness, trend amplitude, recovery, rank/condition number, joint-support nearest-neighbor distance vs TRAIN leave-one-out P95; no significance claims from overlapping rows. Passing numerical gates alone does not establish irreversible aging or calibrated SOH.

holdout_access: P0 clock/segment/validity/window metadata only. No holdout voltage/current/target extraction or model evaluation until a formal target/protocol and all final weights are frozen.
training_gate: No GPU training before P0 and P1 pass. If failed, record P2-P4 NOT_EXECUTED and stop. If passed, register finite seed202 pilot budget and acceptance rules before initializing models; no residual fusion or previous learning-rate candidates.
scientific_scope: Single-cell exploratory long-trend feasibility; no claim of blind test, cross-cell generalization, verified irreversible degradation or true RUL without separate evidence.
